closure_ready_rule: all criteria met and no blocking unsupported claim

criteria.requirement: Only paper.md changes; title, Introduction, Methods, References, section order, and locked records are exact-preserved.
Abstract identifies the prospective matched-cohort/nonrandomized design and uses association rather than causal language with D1 binding.
Abstract reports 71.2%, 52.8%, adjusted 18.4 percentage points, and 95% CI 6.1 to 30.7 with D2 binding.
Abstract names both the design/causal limitation and differential dropout limitation with D1/D3 bindings.
Results reports both rates, adjusted difference, CI, p=0.006, and D2 binding.
Results reports 8.7% versus 3.1%, complete-case/no-imputation context, possible upward bias, and D3 binding.
Results calls ward subgroup exploratory and not preregistered, avoids confirmatory heterogeneity, and binds D3.
Discussion uses association language, explains the design cannot establish causation, avoids deployment recommendation, and binds D1/D2.
Discussion explains complete-case differential dropout may bias the association upward and binds D3.
Discussion treats the subgroup as exploratory/nonconfirmatory and not evidence of heterogeneity, with D3 binding.
Design, primary-result, and quality/subgroup claims are locally bound to D1, D2, and D3 respectively; no undefined source is added.
Abstract, Results, and Discussion agree on design, figures, missingness, subgroup status, and claim strength.
No unsupported statistic, source, causation statement, directional subgroup claim, dismissal of missingness, or deployment recommendation appears.
